title: Local agents
intro: A hosted Floorbit can't reach LibreNMS on the event network. A local agent runs there instead, connects out to this Floorbit and answers its questions. Nothing on the event network has to be reachable from outside.
none: No agent yet. Floorbit asks its own monitoring plugin.
inUse: While an agent is enrolled, Floorbit asks the agent instead of its own monitoring plugin. Revoke every agent to go back.
outdatedHelp: Speaks an older agent protocol than this Floorbit ({{v}}). Pull the new floorbit-agent image and start the agent again.
stats_one: 1 call in the last hour, answered in {{ms}} ms
stats_other: {{count}} calls in the last hour, answered in {{ms}} ms (median)
statsNone: No calls in the last hour
hallsHelp: With an agent per hall, each answers for its own switches; the device list comes from all of them.
revokeQuestion: Revoke {{name}}? It stops at its next request and needs a new key.
name: Name
nameHelp: The event or the site it runs at, such as “Spring LAN, hall 2”.
madeHelp: Copy the key now: it is shown this once. Give it to the agent as FLOORBIT_AGENT_KEY.
runTitle: Start the agent on the event network
docs: How the agent works and what it is asked: docs/agent.md.
